subject: POC readiness checklist — hosting options & evaluation gating
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa@everwellhealth.com>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@everwell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC readiness checklist — hosting options & evaluation gating

Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo today — appreciated the transparency on throughput expectations and the HIPAA-adjacent controls you need. Quick recap and a proposed path to get the POC scheduled next week. I summarized owners, gating criteria, and the three hosting options we discussed so we can pick one and lock dates.

Call highlights (short):
- Primary goal: validate end-to-end extraction + redaction across 1M tokens/day peak; steady state ~200k tokens/day.
- Latency SLO: 95th <= 350ms for single-turn requests (50 token average).
- Data residency: US-only; PHI in scope for a limited subset of endpoints.
- Security asks: SOC 2 evidence, audit log access, and ability to supply custom KMS in VPC mode.

Proposed POC success criteria (suggested, can iterate):
1) Functional: 95% extraction accuracy on the provided labeled set (owner: Everwell data team, validator: Everwell/Redwood joint).
2) Performance: maintain latency SLO under weekly load test profile (owner: Redwood SE).
3) Security: evidence of SOC 2 controls + network connectivity proof-of-concept (owner: Everwell infra + Redwood infra).
4) Operational: observed token cost delta within expected band (+/- 20%) when using prefix caching (owner: Everwell product).

Hosting options (tradeoffs & quick ask):
A) Hosted Redwood API (fastest onramp) — good for quick demo, no infra changes. Short timeline but limited KMS/network controls.
B) Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool) — predictable throughput, better isolation, moderate lead time (~1 week to reserve). Supports our audit logs.
C) VPC Private deployment — customer-managed network, supports external KMS (HSM), longer lead time (2–3 weeks) and some firewall rules required.

Immediate asks from Everwell (please reply with):
- Which hosting option do you prefer for the POC (Hosted / Dedicated sandbox / VPC)?
- A single contact for networking (VPN/firewall) if you pick VPC.
- Preferred start window (we proposed Aug 24–28).

Attached: SOC2 evidence request template, a draft mutual action plan, and a simple network diagram placeholder.

Next internal step: once you confirm hosting choice we will schedule a dry-run with Ben on the infra plan and send a final mutual action plan doc.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: everwell_soc2_request.xlsx, mutual_action_plan.docx, network_diag.drawio

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches our internal takeaways. Quick answers from our side:

- Hosting preference: VPC Private deployment. We need the ability to keep PHI traffic inside our VPC and use our KMS.
- Network contact: Tom Bennett (tom.bennett@everwell.com) — he owns our VPN & firewall team.
- Preferred start: Week of Aug 31 would be ideal for our infra calendar. If that's not possible, Sep 7 is our backup.

Questions before we lock dates:
1) For VPC, what firewall ports/protocols do we need to open outbound? Can you confirm IP ranges?
2) Will Redwood manage the VM/agent inside our VPC or is there an appliance we install?
3) Can you confirm that the audit log retention level requested in the SOC2 template is supported in VPC?

We also uploaded the signed NDA and a short questionnaire for legal/procurement to the link you provided — I copied procurement on this thread.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alyssa
Alyssa Morgan
Director of Product, Everwell Health
alyssa@everwellhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa@everwellhealth.com>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@everwell.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 07:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness checklist — hosting options & evaluation gating

Priyom / Lauren —

Following Alyssa's selection of VPC, a few technical clarifications and an internal owner table so we move fast:

Technical notes (high level):
- Deployment model: Redwood will run a lightweight inference agent inside Everwell's VPC (containerized service). We do not require full VM access; the agent establishes an outbound TLS connection to Redwood's control plane for telemetry and model routing.
- Ports/IPs: outbound 443 to our control-plane IP ranges (will provide CIDR block). For direct S3 integration (if you want artifact exchange) allow outbound 443 to s3.amazonaws.com from the agent.
- KMS: we support customer-managed KMS via standard envelope encryption. For HSM-backed KMS we'll need a short key-exchange step (Ben to own).
- Audit logs: VPC mode supports local log shipping to your SIEM; retention policies can be configured — SOC2 template fields are supported.
- Throughput reservation: to meet the 1M token/day peak we recommend reserving a 2-GPU sandbox for the POC during the first two weeks.

Action owner table (proposed):
- Everwell networking & firewall: Tom Bennett (Tom) — network connectivity, firewall ACLs.
- Everwell data validation: Alyssa — labeled set and acceptance tests.
- Redwood infra/SE: Ben Carter — VPC agent deployment, CIDR/IP handoff, test harness for load testing.
- Redwood product/eng: Lauren Bishop — POC success metric monitoring, cost telemetry, rollback policy.
- Redwood AE: Priyom Das — overall coordination and contract points.

Next steps (we can handle in parallel):
1) Ben will share exact CIDR/IP list and a short runbook for agent setup by EOD today.
2) Priyom to update the mutual_action_plan.docx with the Aug 31 start and owners.
3) Everwell to confirm the VPN/window and provide a ticket for procurement if they plan to use HSM.

I'll prepare a quick dry-run checklist for the agent install so Aug 31 can be a day-0 ramp if all goes well.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: network_diag.drawio (updated), quick_agent_runbook.md
